proposal.inferred_root_cause: gateway-layer fault reported as gateway_technical_error while card:icici itself is healthy
proposal.reasoning_trace: card:icici is healthy on the rolling window at 92% success over 148 attempts against a 91% portfolio baseline, and the only open notice names card:kkbk, a different issuer on the same method. The issuer is answering normally, so a gateway-scoped code with no supporting telemetry is a thin claim: it is the most likely reading, not a confident one. The open notice on card:kkbk is a different issuer and explains nothing here. Attempt 3 failing identically rules out a one-off switch error. No session is open, so recovery is a scheduling problem: retry on card after 15m, which is how long gateway faults of this shape usually take to clear. This is the last attempt the stop rule permits, so it is spent after the window rather than inside it.
